```dataviewjs
// obsidian-planning v0.5.4 - generated by scripts/build.js - do not edit by hand
// src/config.js — USER_CONFIG, the one block a user edits in the generated bundle.
// This file is FIRST in every artifact's build list, so after `npm run build` the
// USER_CONFIG object is the first thing in the planning.md / daily.md code block.
// Pure module (no Obsidian/Dataview dependencies) — testable directly.
//
// Fields:
//   folders    — vault folder(s) holding task notes: a string or an array of strings.
//   startHour  — workday start (24h clock). 9 = 09:00.
//   hoursPerDay — workday length in hours.

const USER_CONFIG = {
  folders: 'Projets',
  startHour: 9,
  hoursPerDay: 8,
  // Days with no working capacity (holidays, vacation). Each entry is a
  // 'YYYY-MM-DD' date or a 'YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD' inclusive range.
  nonWorkingDays: [],
};

// Dataview folder query for the configured folder(s).
// A single folder  -> '"Projets"'
// Multiple folders  -> '"A" or "B"' (Dataview's source "or" syntax)
// Empty/invalid     -> '""' (matches nothing — the dashboard shows its empty state
//                      instead of scanning the whole vault by accident).
function folderQuery(folders) {
  // null/undefined -> the configured default (same as calling with no argument).
  if (folders == null) folders = USER_CONFIG.folders;
  const list = (Array.isArray(folders) ? folders : [folders])
    .filter(f => typeof f === 'string' && f.trim())
    .map(f => f.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, ''));
  if (!list.length) return '""';
  return list.map(f => `"${f}"`).join(' or ');
}

// Expand USER_CONFIG.nonWorkingDays into a Set of 'YYYY-MM-DD' keys.
// Accepts single dates ('2026-12-25') and inclusive ranges ('2026-07-20/2026-08-07').
// Invalid or non-string entries are ignored (a holiday typo must not break the
// schedule; the plan just treats that day as a normal workday).
function nonWorkingSet(days) {
  const set = new Set();
  const list = Array.isArray(days) ? days : (days != null ? [days] : []);
  const valid = (iso) => {
    const d = new Date(iso + 'T00:00:00Z');
    return !isNaN(d.getTime()) && d.toISOString().slice(0, 10) === iso;
  };
  for (const entry of list) {
    if (typeof entry !== 'string') continue;
    const m = entry.match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})(?:\s*\/\s*(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}))?$/);
    if (!m || !valid(m[1])) continue;
    if (!m[2]) { set.add(m[1]); continue; }
    if (!valid(m[2])) continue;
    let d = new Date(m[1] + 'T00:00:00Z');
    const end = new Date(m[2] + 'T00:00:00Z');
    let guard = 0;
    while (d <= end && guard++ < 4000) {
      set.add(d.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
      d = new Date(d.getTime() + 86400000);
    }
  }
  return set;
}



// Emoji Constants
// DO NOT EDIT - Use escape sequences from EMOJI_REFERENCE.md
// AI MUST use these constants. NEVER use literal emoji.
// ALL emoji MUST use \u{XXXXXX} format - these are Unicode escape sequences

// Define emoji using Unicode escape sequences
// These are interpreted by JavaScript as the actual Unicode characters
const P0 = '\u{1F53A}';  // U+1F53A: UP-POINTING RED TRIANGLE
const P1 = '\u{23EB}';  // U+23EB: BLACK UP-POINTING DOUBLE TRIANGLE  
const P2 = '\u{1F53C}';  // U+1F53C: UP-POINTING TRIANGLE
const P3 = '\u{1F53D}';  // U+1F53D: DOWN-POINTING TRIANGLE
const P4 = '\u{23EC}';  // U+23EC: BLACK DOWN-POINTING DOUBLE TRIANGLE
const CLOCK_CHAR = '\u{23F1}';  // U+23F1: STOPWATCH
const CHECK_CHAR = '\u{2705}';  // U+2705: GREEN CHECK MARK
const CALENDAR_CHAR = '\u{1F4C5}';  // U+1F4C5: CALENDAR
const ID_CHAR = '\u{1F194}';  // U+1F194: SQUARED CL
const BLOCK_CHAR = '\u{26D4}';  // U+26D4: CROSSED SWORDS

const CLOCK = CLOCK_CHAR;
const CHECK = CHECK_CHAR;
const CALENDAR = CALENDAR_CHAR;
const ID_MARKER = ID_CHAR;
const BLOCK_MARKER = BLOCK_CHAR;

const PRIORITY = {
  P0: P0,
  P1: P1,
  P2: P2,
  P3: P3,
  P4: P4,
};

const PRIORITY_RANK = {
  [P0]: 0,
  [P1]: 1,
  [P2]: 2,
  [P3]: 3,
  [P4]: 4,
};

const PRIORITY_DEFAULT = 2;

// Emoji for each priority rank (reverse of PRIORITY_RANK).
const PRIORITY_BY_RANK = {
  0: P0,
  1: P1,
  2: P2,
  3: P3,
  4: P4,
};

// Map a numeric priority rank to its emoji (defaults to P2).
function priorityEmoji(rank) {
  return PRIORITY_BY_RANK[rank] != null ? PRIORITY_BY_RANK[rank] : PRIORITY_BY_RANK[PRIORITY_DEFAULT];
}

// Regex patterns
// In template literals used with new RegExp(), we need to double-escape backslashes
// \s becomes \\s, \d becomes \\d, etc.

const priorityRe = new RegExp(
  `(${P0}|${P1}|${P2}|${P3}|${P4})\\uFE0F?`,
  'u'
);

const durRe = new RegExp(
  `(${CLOCK_CHAR}:: *(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)h)|${CLOCK_CHAR} *(\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?)h`,
  'u'
);

const dateRe = new RegExp(
  `${CALENDAR_CHAR}\\s*\\[*\\s*(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2})(?:\\s*\\]*\\s*(\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2}))?`,
  'u'
);

const idRe = new RegExp(
  `${ID_CHAR}\\s*([\\w-]+)`,
  'u'
);

// Completion date marker (✅ YYYY-MM-DD). Optional surrounding brackets/spaces are tolerated.
const completionRe = new RegExp(
  `${CHECK_CHAR} *\\[*\\s*([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})`,
  'u'
);

const blkRe = new RegExp(
  `${BLOCK_CHAR}\\s*([\\w,\\-\\s]+)`,
  'u'
);

// Helper functions
function parsePriority(text) {
  const pm = text.match(priorityRe);
  return pm ? PRIORITY_RANK[pm[1]] : PRIORITY_DEFAULT;
}

function fmtHours(h) {
  return h.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '');
}

// --- Completion-date filtering (used by the Completed Tasks month filter) ---

// Parse a "YYYY-MM-DD" completion date into { year: number, month: number(1-12) }, or null.
function completionMonth(compDate) {
  if (!compDate) return null;
  const m = String(compDate).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})/);
  return m ? { year: +m[1], month: +m[2] } : null;
}

// Filter completed tasks to those finished in the given year/month (month is 1-12).
function filterByCompletionMonth(completed, year, month) {
  return (completed || []).filter((t) => {
    const cm = completionMonth(t.compDate);
    return cm && cm.year === year && cm.month === month;
  });
}

// Full completion date key "YYYY-MM-DD", or null if missing/unparseable.
function completionKey(compDate) {
  if (!compDate) return null;
  const m = String(compDate).match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);
  return m ? `${m[1]}-${m[2]}-${m[3]}` : null;
}

// True only for a complete "YYYY-MM-DD" date.
function isCompleteDate(v) {
  return /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(String(v));
}

// Normalize typed input to "YYYY-MM-DD". Accepts a raw digit string ("20260915") or a
// partially typed one; leaves short input untouched so the field stays usable while typing.
// Once the year (4 digits) is present, the month/day are appended exactly as typed
// (slice(4,6)/slice(6,8) keep 1 or 2 digits), so a partial month like "2026-0" or a partial
// day like "2026-09-1" survive instead of being dropped.
function normDate(v) {
  const d = String(v).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (d.length < 4) return v;
  let out = d.slice(0, 4);
  if (d.length >= 5) out += '-' + d.slice(4, 6);
  if (d.length >= 7) out += '-' + d.slice(6, 8);
  return out;
}

// Inclusive completion-date range filter. Empty bounds are treated as open-ended.
// Dates are compared as "YYYY-MM-DD" strings (lexicographic order == chronological order).
function filterByCompletionRange(completed, startKey, endKey) {
  return (completed || []).filter((t) => {
    const k = completionKey(t.compDate);
    if (!k) return false;
    if (startKey && k < startKey) return false;
    if (endKey && k > endKey) return false;
    return true;
  });
}

// First / last day ("YYYY-MM-DD") of a month (month is 1-12).
function monthStartKey(year, month) {
  return `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;
}
function monthEndKey(year, month) {
  // new Date(year, month, 0) => last day of `month` (month is 1-12).
  const lastDay = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
  return `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(lastDay).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

// The current year/month from a luxon DateTime (has numeric .year/.month) or a native Date.
// Defaults to now when nothing usable is provided.
function currentMonth(today) {
  if (today && typeof today.year === 'number' && typeof today.month === 'number') {
    return { year: today.year, month: today.month };
  }
  const d = today instanceof Date ? today : new Date();
  return { year: d.getFullYear(), month: d.getMonth() + 1 };
}

// Build the markdown line shown for a completed task, e.g.:
//   - [x] Formulaire de demande de formation 📅 [[[2026-09-15](2026-09-15)]] ⏱ 1h ⏫ ✅ 2026-09-15
// Input `t` fields: title, dlStr (YYYY-MM-DD), hours (>0 to show), priority (rank), compDate (YYYY-MM-DD).
function formatCompletedLine(t) {
  const out = ['- [x]'];
  if (t.title) out.push(t.title);
  if (t.dlStr) out.push(`${CALENDAR} [[[${t.dlStr}](${t.dlStr})]]`);
  if (t.hours && t.hours > 0) out.push(`${CLOCK} ${fmtHours(t.hours)}h`);
  out.push(priorityEmoji(t.priority));
  if (t.compDate) out.push(`${CHECK} ${t.compDate}`);
  return out.join(' ');
}

function ownDur(t) {
  const dm = t.text.match(durRe);
  if (!dm) return 0;
  const num = dm[2] || dm[3];
  return num ? parseFloat(num) : 0;
}

function cleanTitle(text) {
  // Remove all metadata markers from the START of text to end of line
  // In Obsidian, metadata appears at the beginning: "📅 2024-01-01 ⏱:: 2h actual task"
  // This pattern removes from the first metadata char to the end
  const metadataChars = `${CALENDAR_CHAR}${ID_CHAR}${BLOCK_CHAR}${P0}${P1}${P2}${P3}${P4}`;
  const metadataPattern = new RegExp(
    `[${metadataChars}\\uFE0F].*`,
    'u'
  );
  return text
    .replace(metadataPattern, '')
    .replace(durRe, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}

function baseName(p) {
  return p.split('/').pop().replace(/\.md$/, '');
}



// src/utils.js - Shared utility functions for rendering modules
// These are Obsidian/Dataview dependent - not testable outside Obsidian

// Helper functions for HTML escaping
function esc(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

function escA(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/</g, '&lt;');
}

function renderMd(s) {
  let h = esc(s);
  h = h.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
      .replace(/~~(.+?)~~/g, '<del>$1</del>')
      .replace(/`(.+?)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
  return h;
}

function clip(s, k) {
  return s.length > k ? s.slice(0, k - 1) + '\u2026' : s;
}

// Task opener utility - creates a function to open tasks in Obsidian
function makeTaskOpener(app) {
  // Select a task line in an open markdown view. `leafHint` is the leaf returned by the
  // synchronous part of openFile(): when the file is opened in a NEW tab the workspace's
  // leaf list only exposes it after the view loads, so searching leaves alone races the
  // load and gives up after the retries. Preferring the hint first, then falling back to
  // the workspace search, makes the line selection work for left and middle click alike.
  function selectLine(path, line, tries, leafHint) {
    // Prefer an already-open leaf (avoids hijacking a duplicate new tab), then fall back
    // to the opened leaf as hint — when the file opens in a NEW tab the workspace's leaf
    // list only exposes it after the view loads, so the hint is the only reliable handle.
    const candidates = [];
    for (const l of app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown')) candidates.push(l);
    if (leafHint) candidates.push(leafHint);
    const target = candidates.find(l =>
      l && l.view && l.view.file && l.view.file.path === path && l.view.editor
    );
    if (target) {
      app.workspace.setActiveLeaf(target, { focus: true });
      const ed = target.view.editor;
      const len = (ed.getLine(line) || '').length;
      ed.setSelection({ line, ch: 0 }, { line, ch: len });
      ed.scrollIntoView({ from: { line, ch: 0 }, to: { line, ch: len } }, true);
      ed.focus();
    }
    else if (tries > 0) setTimeout(() => selectLine(path, line, tries - 1), 50);
  }
  function openAt(el) {
    const p = el.getAttribute('data-path');
    const l = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-line'), 10);
    // getLeaf('tab') returns a leaf whose view is replaced asynchronously; openFile
    // resolves with the same leaf, so pass it through as the selection hint.
    const leaf = app.workspace.getLeaf('tab');
    leaf.openFile(app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(p), {
      active: true,
      state: { line: l }
    });
    selectLine(p, l, 12, leaf);
  }
  return (el) => {
    el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      openAt(el);
    });
    el.addEventListener('auxclick', (e) => {
      if (e.button === 1) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        openAt(el);
      }
    });
  };
}

// Shared openTask instance (will be initialized in main)
let openTask = null;

// Mark a task line as completed by appending the \u2705 completion marker with
// today's date, via vault.process (atomic read-modify-write). Returns true when
// the line was modified. Refuses when the line already carries a completion
// date or when the line index is out of range, so double clicks are no-ops.
function makeTaskCompleter(app, todayISO) {
  return (path, line) => {
    try {
      const file = app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(path);
      if (!file || file.path !== path) return false;
      let changed = false;
      app.vault.process(file, (text) => {
        const lines = text.split('\n');
        if (line < 0 || line >= lines.length) return text;
        if (/\u2705/.test(lines[line])) return text;
        lines[line] = lines[line].replace(/\s*$/, '') + ' \u2705 ' + todayISO;
        changed = true;
        return lines.join('\n');
      });
      return changed;
    } catch (_) {
      return false;
    }
  };
}

// Shared completeTask instance (initialized in main, once today is known).
let completeTask = null;

// Initialize openTask when dv is available
if (typeof dv !== 'undefined' && dv.app) {
  openTask = makeTaskOpener(dv.app);
  completeTask = makeTaskCompleter(dv.app, dv.date('today').toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd'));
}

// Attach the \u2713 done-buttons inside a rendered panel. Each button marks its
// task line completed (\u2705 today) in the source note; the row then greys out.
// The click stops propagation so the row's own open-on-click keeps working, and
// a successful completion disables the button to make double clicks no-ops.
function wireDoneButtons(panel) {
  panel.querySelectorAll('.done-btn').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      e.preventDefault();
      if (btn.dataset.done === '1') return;
      const ok = completeTask && completeTask(btn.getAttribute('data-path'), parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-line'), 10));
      if (ok) {
        btn.dataset.done = '1';
        btn.style.color = 'rgb(129,181,98)';
        btn.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
        btn.title = 'Completed today \u2014 refresh to see the plan update';
      }
    });
  });
}



// src/parser.js - Data collection and parsing for Obsidian tasks
// This file uses dv and Obsidian-specific data structures
// It's NOT testable outside Obsidian


// --- Completion extraction (shared, pure) ---
// Parses the completion metadata of a finished ([x]) task. Kept pure (only `text` + identity
// fields) so both `collectAll` (main dashboard) and the daily-note view parse ✅ completion
// dates identically — a single source of truth for what "done" means.
function extractCompletedTask({ text, path, file, line }) {
  const km = text.match(dateRe);
  const dm = text.match(completionRe);
  const noComp = text.replace(completionRe, '');
  return {
    title: cleanTitle(noComp),
    path,
    file,
    line,
    dlStr: km ? km[1] : null,
    hours: ownDur({ text }),
    priority: parsePriority(text),
    compDate: dm ? dm[1] : null,
  };
}

// --- Data Collection ---
function collectAll(pages) {
  const all = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const warnings = [];
  const completed = [];

  // --- Pass 1: collect every task's ID so dependencies can be validated ---
  // A dep can reference a task defined anywhere in the vault (any page, any order),
  // so the known-ID set must be complete before any ⛔ can be checked. Subtasks are
  // visited explicitly: Dataview lists them flat inside file.tasks, but recursing
  // keeps the set correct under either shape.
  const knownIds = new Set();
  const collectId = (t) => {
    if (t.status !== '-' && !t.completed) {
      const idm = t.text.match(idRe);
      if (idm) knownIds.add(idm[1].replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/, ''));
    }
    for (const c of t.subtasks ?? []) collectId(c);
  };
  for (const page of pages) {
    for (const t of page.file.tasks) collectId(t);
  }


  for (const page of pages) {
    const path = page.file.path;
    const file = baseName(path);
    const childKeys = new Set();

    const markChildren = (t) => {
      for (const c of t.subtasks ?? []) {
        childKeys.add(`${path}:${c.line}`);
        markChildren(c);
      }
    };

    for (const t of page.file.tasks) markChildren(t);

    for (const t of page.file.tasks) {
      if (t.status === '-') continue;
      // Completed ([x]) tasks are kept only for the completion log; they are never scheduled.
      if (t.completed) {
        completed.push(extractCompletedTask({ text: t.text, path, file, line: t.line }));
        continue;
      }
      const key = `${path}:${t.line}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);

      const km = t.text.match(dateRe);
      const idm = t.text.match(idRe);
      const blm = t.text.match(blkRe);
      const priority = parsePriority(t.text);
      let ownDL = null;
      let locked = false;
      let mDate = null;
      let mHour = 0;
      let mMin = 0;
      const parsingErrors = [];

      try {
        if (km) {
          if (km[2] != null) {
            locked = true;
            mDate = dv.date(km[1]);
            mHour = +km[2];
            mMin = +km[3];
            if (isNaN(mHour) || mHour < 0 || mHour > 23) parsingErrors.push(`Hour invalid: ${km[2]}`);
            if (isNaN(mMin) || mMin < 0 || mMin > 59) parsingErrors.push(`Minute invalid: ${km[3]}`);
            if (!mDate) parsingErrors.push(`Date parse failed: ${km[1]}`);
          } else {
            ownDL = dv.date(km[1]);
            if (!ownDL) parsingErrors.push(`Date parse failed: ${km[1]}`);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        parsingErrors.push(`Exception: ${e.message}`);
      }

      const dur = ownDur(t);
      if (dur < 0) parsingErrors.push(`Negative duration: ${dur}h`);
      const isIndented = childKeys.has(key);

      const taskEntry = {
        key,
        node: t,
        path,
        file,
        line: t.line,
        ownDL,
        locked,
        mDate,
        mHour,
        mMin,
        graphDL: km ? dv.date(km[1]) : null,
        id: idm ? idm[1].replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/, '') : null,
        deps: blm ? blm[1].split(',').map(s => s.trim().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/, '')).filter(Boolean) : [],
        title: cleanTitle(t.text),
        priority,
        isIndented,
        _parsingErrors: parsingErrors,
      };

      // Unknown dependency check (pass 2, once all IDs are known): a ⛔ pointing at an
      // ID that no task carries is a typo or a stale reference — the scheduler can never
      // satisfy it, so surface it like any other malformed metadata instead of silently
      // scheduling the task as if it had no constraint. Completed and cancelled tasks
      // don't count as dependency targets: a dep on finished work is not a scheduling
      // constraint, and treating it as known would hide a stale reference.
      const unknownDeps = taskEntry.deps.filter(dep => !knownIds.has(dep));
      if (unknownDeps.length) {
        parsingErrors.push(`Unknown dependency: ${unknownDeps.join(', ')}`);
      }

      if (parsingErrors.length) {
        warnings.push({ text: t.text, path, line: t.line, errors: parsingErrors });
      }
      all.push(taskEntry);
    }
  }

  return { all, seen, warnings, completed };
}

// --- Graph Building ---
function buildGraph(all) {
  const dependents = {};
  all.forEach(r => r.deps.forEach(dep => {
    dependents[dep] = dependents[dep] || [];
    dependents[dep].push(r);
  }));

  const minDate = (a, b) => (!a ? b : !b ? a : a < b ? a : b);

  function effectiveDL(item) {
    let best = item.ownDL;
    const vis = new Set([item.key]);
    const stack = [item];
    while (stack.length) {
      const cur = stack.pop();
      best = minDate(best, cur.graphDL);
      if (cur.id && dependents[cur.id]) {
        for (const d of dependents[cur.id]) {
          if (!vis.has(d.key)) {
            vis.add(d.key);
            stack.push(d);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  all.forEach(r => r.eff = r.locked ? null : effectiveDL(r));

  function effectivePriority(item) {
    let best = item.priority;
    const vis = new Set([item.key]);
    const stack = [item];
    while (stack.length) {
      const cur = stack.pop();
      best = Math.min(best, cur.priority);
      for (const dep of cur.deps) {
        const depTasks = all.filter(r => r.id === dep);
        for (const dt of depTasks) {
          if (!vis.has(dt.key)) {
            vis.add(dt.key);
            stack.push(dt);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  all.forEach(r => r.effPriority = effectivePriority(r));
  const markSet = new Set(all.filter(r => r.eff).map(r => r.key));

  return { dependents, markSet };
}

// --- Chargeable Hours Calculation ---
function chargeableHours(node, path, markSet) {
  let sum = ownDur(node);
  for (const c of node.subtasks ?? []) {
    if (c.completed || c.status === '-') continue;
    if (markSet.has(`${path}:${c.line}`)) continue;
    sum += chargeableHours(c, path, markSet);
  }
  return sum === 0 ? 0.1 : sum;
}

// --- Main Data Collection ---
function collectPlannerData(pages) {
  const { all, warnings, completed } = collectAll(pages);
  const { dependents, markSet } = buildGraph(all);
  const items = [];
  const locks = [];

  for (const r of all) {
    if (r.locked) {
      // A meeting whose date failed to parse (mDate null) must not become a lock: the
      // scheduler and renderers assume lk.day is a valid DateTime and would crash the
      // whole dashboard. The parsing-error panel already flags the task with the reason.
      if (!r.mDate) continue;
      const h = chargeableHours(r.node, r.path, markSet);
      if (h > 0) {
        locks.push({
          day: r.mDate,
          hour: r.mHour,
          min: r.mMin,
          hours: h,
          title: r.title,
          path: r.path,
          line: r.line,
          file: r.file,
          id: r.id,
          deps: r.deps,
          priority: r.effPriority
        });
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (!r.eff) continue;

    const hours = chargeableHours(r.node, r.path, markSet);
    items.push({
      duration: hours,
      deadline: r.eff,
      title: r.title,
      path: r.path,
      line: r.line,
      file: r.file,
      id: r.id,
      deps: r.deps,
      ownStr: r.ownDL ? r.ownDL.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') : '--',
      inherited: !r.ownDL || r.eff < r.ownDL,
      priority: r.effPriority
    });
  }

  return { tasks: all, items, locks, dependents, markSet, warnings, completed };
}



// src/render/completed.js - Completed tasks tree (Obsidian/Dataview dependent)
// Renders finished ([x]) tasks as a foldable project/subproject tree that mirrors the
// FIRST COLUMN of the Gantt chart: group headers with cumulative hours, task rows with
// individual hours, ▸/▾ fold/unfold, depth indentation, click-to-open tasks.
//
// Example output (group header + task rows):
//   ▾ 📂 Formation (3.25h)
//     Formulaire de demande de formation (1h) ✅ 2026-09-15
//   ▸ 📂 Budget (1.5h)
//
// This is a direct copy of the gantt.js first-column logic, fed with the completed list.



/**
 * Render completed tasks as a foldable tree by project/subproject.
 * Depends on: dv, app, and the completed-tasks list (from the parser).
 *
 * @param {HTMLElement} container
 * @param {Array<{path:string, line:number, title:string, hours:number, compDate:string|null}>} completed
 * @param {DateTime|Date} today
 */
function renderCompleted(container, completed, today, opts = {}) {
  const geo = { pad: 6, step: 14, max: 460 };

  const box = container.createEl('div');
  box.style.cssText = 'font-size:13px;border:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.2);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:4px;';

  // When opts.onlyDate is a valid "YYYY-MM-DD", show exactly that day (daily-note view): no
  // From/To toolbar and a single-date filter. Otherwise (main dashboard) it falls back to the
  // current-month range with the interactive toolbar.
  const onlyDate = opts.onlyDate && isCompleteDate(opts.onlyDate) ? opts.onlyDate : null;

  // Only tasks that have a completion date are ever shown.
  const done = (completed || []).filter(t => t.compDate);

  if (!done.length) {
    box.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:8px;color:gray;font-size:12px;text-align:center;">No completed tasks found.</div>';
    return;
  }

  // Default range = the current month (From = 1st, To = last day).
  const cur = currentMonth(today);
  const startKey = monthStartKey(cur.year, cur.month);
  const endKey = monthEndKey(cur.year, cur.month);

  // --- Build the project/subproject tree (near-identical to gantt.js first column) ---
  const cRoot = { id: '', label: '', children: new Map(), items: [] };

  function cSegsOf(path) {
    const p = path.replace(/\.md$/, '');
    const parts = p.split('/');
    if (parts[0] === 'Projets') parts.shift();
    if (parts.length >= 2 && parts[parts.length - 1] === parts[parts.length - 2]) parts.pop();
    return parts.length ? parts : ['(root)'];
  }
  function cStartOf(t) {
    // Order completed tasks within a branch by completion date (the gantt uses scheduling start).
    const d = t.compDate ? Date.parse(t.compDate) : 0;
    return Number.isFinite(d) ? d : 0;
  }
  function cAddEntry(path, en) {
    const parts = cSegsOf(path);
    let node = cRoot;
    let idAcc = '';
    parts.forEach(seg => {
      idAcc += (idAcc ? '/' : '') + seg;
      if (!node.children.has(seg)) {
        node.children.set(seg, { id: idAcc, label: seg, children: new Map(), items: [] });
      }
      node = node.children.get(seg);
    });
    node.items.push(en);
  }

  // Cumulative hours for a node = sum of its task hours + all descendant group totals.
  function cNodeTotal(node) {
    let sum = 0;
    for (const en of node.items) sum += en.s.hours || 0;
    for (const c of node.children.values()) sum += cNodeTotal(c);
    return sum;
  }
  function cAnnotate(node) {
    node.total = cNodeTotal(node);
    node.children.forEach(c => cAnnotate(c));
  }

  // Earliest completion date among a node's descendants (used to sort branches).
  function cNodeStart(node) {
    let mn = Infinity;
    node.items.forEach(e => mn = Math.min(mn, e.start));
    node.children.forEach(c => mn = Math.min(mn, cNodeStart(c)));
    return mn === Infinity ? 0 : mn;
  }

  const cCollapsed = new Set();
  function cFlatten(node, depth, out) {
    const kids = [...node.children.values()].sort((a, b) => cNodeStart(a) - cNodeStart(b));
    for (const c of kids) {
      out.push({ type: 'group', node: c, depth });
      if (!cCollapsed.has(c.id)) {
        cFlatten(c, depth + 1, out);
        c.items.slice().sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start).forEach(en =>
          out.push(en.k === 'task' ? { type: 'task', s: en.s, depth: depth + 1 } : null)
        );
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function cGroupRow(c, depth) {
    const isColl = cCollapsed.has(c.id);
    const tri = isColl ? '\u25b8' : '\u25be';
    const isLeaf = c.children.size === 0;
    const icon = isLeaf ? '\u{1F4C4}' : '\u{1F4C1}';
    const col = isLeaf ? 'rgb(152,195,121)' : 'rgb(97,175,239)';
    const bg = isLeaf ? 'rgba(152,195,121,0.10)' : 'rgba(97,175,239,0.10)';
    const ind = geo.pad + depth * geo.step;
    const label = esc(clip(c.label, Math.max(8, 34 - depth * 3)));
    return (
      `<div class="cgroup" data-node="${escA(c.id)}" data-label="${escA(c.label)}" ` +
      `style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 8px;padding-left:${ind}px;` +
      `border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.1);background:${bg};cursor:pointer;">` +
      `<span style="color:${col}">${tri}</span><span style="color:${col}">${icon}</span>` +
      `<span style="color:${col};flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${label}</span>` +
      `<span style="color:gray;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;">(${fmtHours(c.total)}h)</span></div>`
    );
  }

  function cTaskRow(t, depth) {
    const ind = geo.pad + depth * geo.step;
    const title = esc(clip(t.title, Math.max(6, 26 - depth * 3)));
    const date = t.compDate ? `<span style="color:gray;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;"> ${CHECK} ${esc(t.compDate)}</span>` : '';
    return (
      `<div class="crow" data-path="${escA(t.path)}" data-line="${t.line}" ` +
      `style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:3px 8px;padding-left:${ind}px;` +
      `border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.1);">` +
      `<span style="color:gray;flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;">${title} (${fmtHours(t.hours)}h)</span>` +
      `${date}</div>`
    );
  }

  function rowsHtml() {
    const rows = cFlatten(cRoot, 0, []);
    let html = '';
    rows.forEach(r => {
      if (r.type === 'group') html += cGroupRow(r.node, r.depth);
      else if (r.type === 'task') html += cTaskRow(r.s, r.depth);
    });
    return html;
  }

  // Rebuild the tree from a visible (already date-filtered) task list and recompute totals.
  function build(visible) {
    cRoot.id = '';
    cRoot.label = '';
    cRoot.children = new Map();
    cRoot.items = [];
    visible.forEach(t => cAddEntry(t.path, { k: 'task', s: t, start: cStartOf(t) }));
    cAnnotate(cRoot);
  }

  // The text field is authoritative for reading the range; it falls back to the default
  // (current month) when empty/incomplete.
  function readRange() {
    if (onlyDate) return { start: onlyDate, end: onlyDate };
    const ts = box.querySelectorAll('.cdate-start-text');
    const te = box.querySelectorAll('.cdate-end-text');
    const s = ts.length ? ts[0].value : '';
    const e = te.length ? te[0].value : '';
    return { start: isCompleteDate(s) ? s : startKey, end: isCompleteDate(e) ? e : endKey };
  }

  // Build the toolbar with the CURRENT range baked into the inputs, so a rebuild does not
  // discard a user's selection.
  function buildToolbar(start, end) {
    return '<div style="margin:4px 0;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">' +
      '<label style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">From</label>' +
      `<input class="cdate-start-date" type="date" value="${start}" style="padding:2px 18px 2px 4px;width:140px;">` +
      `<input class="cdate-start-text" type="text" inputmode="date" pattern="[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}" maxlength="10" value="${start}" style="padding:2px 4px;width:110px;">` +
      '<label style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);">To</label>' +
      `<input class="cdate-end-date" type="date" value="${end}" style="padding:2px 18px 2px 4px;width:140px;">` +
      `<input class="cdate-end-text" type="text" inputmode="date" pattern="[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}" maxlength="10" value="${end}" style="padding:2px 4px;width:110px;">` +
      '<button type="button" class="cfoldall" style="cursor:pointer;padding:2px 8px;">fold all</button>' +
      '<button type="button" class="cunfoldall" style="cursor:pointer;padding:2px 8px;">unfold all</button></div>';
  }

  const listWrap = '<div style="overflow:auto;max-height:' + geo.max + 'px;">';

  function render() {
    const { start, end } = readRange();
    const visible = filterByCompletionRange(done, start, end);

    // Single-day view: when the requested day has no completed tasks, surface the empty state
    // instead of an empty bordered box. (Main dashboard keeps the toolbar + its own empty check.)
    if (onlyDate && visible.length === 0) {
      box.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:8px;color:gray;font-size:12px;text-align:center;">No completed tasks found.</div>';
      return;
    }

    build(visible);

    box.innerHTML = (onlyDate ? '' : buildToolbar(start, end)) + listWrap + rowsHtml() + '</div>';

    // Re-bind handlers after each rebuild (querySelectorAll is a no-op in the test mock).
    box.querySelectorAll('.cfoldall').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => {
      cFlatten(cRoot, 0, []).filter(r => r.type === 'group').forEach(r => cCollapsed.add(r.node.id));
      render();
    });
    box.querySelectorAll('.cunfoldall').forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { cCollapsed.clear(); render(); });
    box.querySelectorAll('.cgroup').forEach(g => g.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const id = g.getAttribute('data-node');
      if (!id) return;
      if (cCollapsed.has(id)) cCollapsed.delete(id); else cCollapsed.add(id);
      render();
    }));
    box.querySelectorAll('.crow').forEach(el => openTask(el));

    // Date filters: typing a date (or picking one in the calendar) re-filters the tree and
    // keeps the date/text fields in sync. Each date field sits right after its text field,
    // so a text field's previous sibling is its date field and vice versa.
    box.querySelectorAll('.cdate-start-text, .cdate-end-text').forEach(f =>
      f.addEventListener('input', e => {
        const el = e.currentTarget;
        if (isCompleteDate(el.value)) {
          const dateEl = el.previousElementSibling;
          if (dateEl) dateEl.value = el.value;
          render();
        }
      }),
    );
    box.querySelectorAll('.cdate-start-date, .cdate-end-date').forEach(f =>
      f.addEventListener('change', e => {
        const el = e.currentTarget;
        const textEl = el.nextElementSibling;
        if (textEl) textEl.value = el.value;
        render();
      }),
    );
  }

  render();
}



// src/render/daily_notes.js — "Completed today" view for a daily-note template.
// Shows the /Projets tasks completed on the day the block lives in, reusing the SAME grouped tree
// as the main dashboard's completed panel (renderCompleted, onlyDate mode) — one source of truth
// for both the monthly range view and the single-day view.




// Collect finished ([x]) tasks from /Projets pages into the shared completion shape. Only tasks
// with a completion date ever reach renderCompleted (it filters on compDate), so tasks marked
// done without a completion marker are naturally excluded from the daily view.
function collectDailyCompleted(pages) {
  const done = [];
  for (const page of pages || []) {
    const path = page.file.path;
    const file = baseName(path);
    for (const t of page.file.tasks) {
      if (!t.completed) continue;
      done.push(extractCompletedTask({ text: t.text, path, file, line: t.line }));
    }
  }
  return done;
}

// Render the daily completed view. `dailyTitle` is the daily note's title (yyyy-mm-dd) or null
// when the current note is not a date-named daily note (then show a hint instead of an empty tree).
function renderDailyCompleted(container, pages, today, dailyTitle) {
  // The header is always shown; the body below it depends on whether this note is a dated daily.
  container.createEl('div', { text: 'Completed today' }).style.cssText =
    'margin-top:24px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;';

  if (!isCompleteDate(dailyTitle)) {
    container.createEl('div', {
      text: 'Paste this block into a dated daily note (file name YYYY-MM-DD) to see tasks completed that day.'
    }).style.cssText =
      'font-size:12px;color:gray;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,0.2);border-radius:6px;margin-top:4px;';
    return;
  }
  const done = collectDailyCompleted(pages);
  renderCompleted(container, done, today, { onlyDate: dailyTitle });
}



// src/daily_notes.js — entry point for the daily-note template (bundled into daily.md).
// Mirrors index.js: shows the /Projets tasks completed on the day of the daily note it lives in.
// It uses dv, dv.app, and other Obsidian APIs, same as index.js.


const pages = dv.pages('"Projets"');

const today = dv.date('today');

// The daily note's title (its file name without extension) is the date the view is filtered to.
// Guarded because dv.current() / file.name are the source of truth and must exist in Obsidian.
const current = (dv.current && dv.current()) || null;
const dailyTitle = current && current.file ? current.file.name : null;

renderDailyCompleted(dv.container, pages, today, dailyTitle);
```
